acip: GANG GI TSE GZHAN SKYE DGAG PA 'DI LA DON DAM GYI KHYAD PAR SBYOR BA YIN PA DE'I TSE, JI LTAR MIG NI RAB RIB CAN GYI SHES PAS SKRA SHAD LA SOGS PA DMIGS PAS, RAB RIB KYIS MA BSLAD PA'I SHES PA LA SKRA SHAD SOGS MI SNANG BA LA GNOD PA MIN PA
english: Suppose that as we deny that things could grow from things other than themselves, we apply the distinction that we are referring here to growing in an ultimate sense. Think then of how a state of mind influenced by eyes clouded with cataracts perceives a strand of hair, or something similar. This state of mind cannot draw into question the way in which no strand of hair or the like ever makes its appearance to a state of mind which is not infected by such cataracts.
